notes: The standalone program CLI and its two sibling dependencies are copied to an empty temporary directory and invoked with -I -S. No project Python/PyMTL imports are required.

The five public data/control/payload/host/NoC layouts are compared to the original measured frozen schemas where available. Five profiles independently assign each individual bit through real SV struct fields and compare with the tool packing: 3950 checks.

All 124 generated heterogeneous host packets exactly match the frozen hexadecimal words (CRLF reference versus LF output), including 25 control words, 20 constants and eight store packets. Native extension opcodes are recorded separately from the 99 original opcode definitions and 59 commands.

Nine unittest groups cover signed limits, sparse array ordering, random round trips, schema errors, wrong selectors and target/storage ranges, cumulative constant capacity, nonzero Context entry, preload limits, barriers, reproducibility and no overwrite.

The generated architecture plus generated program complete all 21 PEs and eight independently checked reads; the driver honors the explicit cumulative completion barrier. The old no-barrier input driver also passes. Wrong output, permanent backpressure and an impossible pre-program barrier must fail.
Constants replay without freeing loading capacity; only Context TERMINATE clears the tracked per-Tile count within a program stream. External global reset separates streams.

Raw packet mode validates wire widths and known field names; encoding a numeric reserved value is not a claim that a configured FU, Tile or system implements it. No DAG mapper or complete static scheduling/liveness proof is introduced.

The first packing harness assumed fscanf returns -1 at EOF. Verilator returned zero; the final harness accepts EOF with no parsed value, still requires the exact number of field checks and rejects extra values or non-EOF trailing input. All five final profiles passed without disabling assertions or RTL optimization.
Existing UNOPTFLAT warnings from the full fabric are recorded, not suppressed or treated as a full-system SCC proof. That refresh remains a later task.
